== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultAliasSurfaceBoardingEncounter.psc</code> source file.

<source>
Script for ships on the surface of a planet. When the ship lands, start a Boarding Encounter to manage the crew in the ship's interior.
</source>

{{Script_Object_Member_Summary
| title = CrewSizePercent
| script = [[SFM:Script-DefaultAliasSurfaceBoardingEncounter|DefaultAliasSurfaceBoardingEncounter]]
| name = [[SFM:Script-DefaultAliasSurfaceBoardingEncounter/CrewSizePercent|CrewSizePercent]]
| kind = Property
| flags = Auto Const
| returns = float
| parameters = 1.0
| documentation = DEFAULT=1.0. Multiply the Boarding Encounter's base crew and corpse counts by this value.
	For example, if your encounter spawns actors outside the ship to fight the player, you might want half the usual crew in the ship (0.5).
	Note that reducing a ship's crew size with this multiplier also reduces its default loot accordingly.
}}
